description: Test whether a long antisense ORF comparable to VAM10 exists inside the VPS5 gene of 15 Saccharomycetaceae species
code:
import requests, time, json, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

S = requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
EU="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"

TARGETS = {
 "S. cerevisiae S288C":"854235", "S. paradoxus":"54633636",
 "N. glabratus (C. glabrata)":"2891033", "K. africana":"13885848",
 "N. dairenensis":"11497156", "T. phaffii":"11533094",
 "T. delbrueckii":"11504303", "Z. rouxii":"8201976",
 "L. thermotolerans":"8293188", "K. lactis":"2895646",
 "K. marxianus":"34715552", "E. gossypii":"4620469",
 "E. cymbalariae":"11472381", "H. blattae":"14492685",
 "H. naganishii":"34528585",
}
sm = S.get(EU+"esummary.fcgi", params=dict(db="gene", id=",".join(TARGETS.values()), retmode="json"), timeout=90).json()["result"]
def efetch_region(acc,s,e,strand):
    t=S.get(EU+"efetch.fcgi", params=dict(db="nuccore",id=acc,rettype="fasta",retmode="text",
            seq_start=s,seq_stop=e,strand=strand), timeout=120).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
SEQS={}
for nm,gid in TARGETS.items():
    L=sm[gid]["genomicinfo"][0]; a,b=int(L["chrstart"]),int(L["chrstop"])
    s,e,st=(a+1,b+1,1) if a<=b else (b+1,a+1,2)
    SEQS[nm]=efetch_region(L["chraccver"],s,e,st); time.sleep(0.3)

bases="TCAG"; aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={}; i=0
for b1 in bases:
    for b2 in bases:
        for b3 in bases:
            CODON[b1+b2+b3]=aas[i]; i+=1
def tr(s): return "".join(CODON.get(s[k:k+3],"X") for k in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
COMP=str.maketrans("ACGTN","TGCAN")
def rc(s): return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]

VAM10="MLFEVFGEVLASYIVSSKTKGELAFPVNNAPPDSLVAINCVVLFLRSAIGSCSGAKELIRSSALELSCSSSCGLPATDKPGSFHSGALSKSILSANEAVVSKSSLSFLSSFVDI"

def antisense_orfs(gene):
    """longest ATG..stop ORF and longest stop-free run on the reverse complement of the gene"""
    r = rc(gene)
    best_orf=0; best_run=0; best_seq=""
    for f in range(3):
        p = tr(r[f:])
        # longest stop-free run
        for seg in p.split("*"):
            if len(seg)>best_run: best_run=len(seg)
        # longest ATG-initiated ORF terminated by stop
        for seg in p.split("*"):
            k = seg.find("M")
            if k>=0 and len(seg)-k > best_orf:
                best_orf = len(seg)-k; best_seq = seg[k:]
    return best_orf, best_run, best_seq

rows=[]
for nm,g in SEQS.items():
    prot = tr(g).rstrip("*")
    o,run,seq = antisense_orfs(g)
    rows.append(dict(species=nm, gene_nt=len(g), vps5_aa=len(prot),
                     internal_stops=prot.count("*"),
                     antisense_longest_ORF_aa=o, antisense_longest_stopfree_aa=run,
                     orf_seq=seq))
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("antisense_longest_ORF_aa", ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",200)
print(df[["species","gene_nt","vps5_aa","internal_stops","antisense_longest_ORF_aa","antisense_longest_stopfree_aa"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nS. cerevisiae antisense ORF == Vam10p ?",
      df.loc[df.species=="S. cerevisiae S288C","orf_seq"].iloc[0]==VAM10)
json.dump({r["species"]:r["orf_seq"] for r in rows}, open("/tmp/x.json","w"))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.5))
d=df.sort_values("antisense_longest_ORF_aa")
cols=["#c2410c" if s=="S. cerevisiae S288C" else "#64748b" for s in d.species]
ax.barh(d.species, d.antisense_longest_ORF_aa, color=cols)
ax.axvline(114, ls="--", c="#c2410c", lw=1)
ax.text(116, 0.2, "Vam10p = 114 aa", color="#c2410c", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Longest ATG-initiated ORF on the antisense strand of the VPS5 gene (aa)")
ax.set_title("VAM10 is the only long antisense ORF inside VPS5 across Saccharomycetaceae")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
